events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Ham-hello!The Hamster Time demo is out today!Hamster Time is a cute, lightweight game you can keep running on your desktop while you get other things done.Here’s what you’ll find in the demo:26 Common-tier hamsters + 2 special characters128 hats29 hamster wheels3 multiplayer modesA focus and break timerA to-do listPlease share any bug reports or feedback about the demo on the Steam Community or in our Discord server!Hamk you!

events.title: Adding More Wheels
